metadata.description: Refactor Codument around XML specs, VFS URI selectors, project attractors, feature-gated knowledge sync, durable decisions, optional memory, minute-level archive paths, and large-track proposal/design subdirectories.

phase.name: Foundation: VFS, feature config, and track metadata

task.name: Add VFS URI model and parser
task.description: Implement a small typed parser/resolver model for spec, decision, memory, attractor, track, archive, knowledge, and test URI schemes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Parser accepts valid URI examples from design/spec-vfs-and-xml.md
Parser rejects malformed or unsupported schemes with diagnostic errors
Unit tests cover all required URI schemes

task.name: Add feature config loader
task.description: Load codument/config/feature.json with missing-file defaults for disabled knowledgeSync and projectMemory.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Missing feature.json behaves as knowledgeSync=false and projectMemory=false
Existing feature.json is parsed without mutating content
Absolute knowledge target roots are represented but not guessed

task.name: Add track updatedAt resolver
task.description: Resolve track last update time from plan.xml metadata and fallback to max file mtime.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: updated_at from plan.xml is used when present and current
Max file mtime fallback works for manually edited tracks
Minute-level local prefix can be generated deterministically

phase.name: Spec XML registry and mutation protocol

task.name: Define XML spec schema and parser
task.description: Implement parsing for capability, requirement, statement, suite, case, given, when, then, include, and examples.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Single-file XML capability parses successfully
Folder-based capability with index.xml and include nodes parses successfully
Nested suite/case structure is preserved in logical AST

task.name: Implement generic XML spec patch apply
task.description: Apply upsert, delete, and move operations using spec:// selectors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: upsert can add or replace a case node
delete can remove a selected node
move can move a selected node to another spec URI
Operations do not depend on physical file paths

task.name: Keep Markdown spec compatibility
task.description: Keep existing Markdown specs readable during migration and avoid breaking list/show/validate behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing codument/specs/codument-core/spec.md remains listable
XML specs and Markdown specs can coexist

phase.name: Attractors, init, upgrade, and standard guidance

task.name: Update init directory generation
task.description: Create codument/attractors and codument/config for new projects, generate product/project attractors, and stop generating tech-stack.md for new projects.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New init creates codument/attractors/product.md
New init creates codument/attractors/project.md
New init creates codument/config/feature.json with defaults
New init does not create codument/tech-stack.md

task.name: Update upgrade-workspace compatibility
task.description: Ensure upgrade-workspace upgrades old workspaces to the new format, creates missing attractors/config safely, and preserves legacy content that cannot be safely converted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Old workspaces are upgraded with missing codument/attractors and codument/config/feature.json
Existing feature.json config values are preserved
Existing attractor files are not overwritten
Legacy product/project/tech-stack files are not destructively removed
Unsafe-to-convert Markdown specs remain readable in codument/specs
Unsafe-to-convert Markdown specs are copied to codument/legacy/specs
Temporary upgrade backups do not replace codument/legacy preservation

task.name: Update std AGENTS and prompt templates
task.description: Update standard guidance to read codument/attractors/ as a directory and avoid fixed attractor file assumptions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: std AGENTS references codument/attractors/ directory
std AGENTS allows user-defined attractor files
tech-stack is no longer presented as a required new-project truth source

task.name: Update archive path generation
task.description: Write new archive directories under codument/archive/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD-HHmm-track-id using track last update time.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Archive uses track updated_at instead of command execution date
Archive path includes YYYY-MM bucket
Late archive preserves original iteration ordering
Old archive directories remain readable

task.name: Add durable decisions registry
task.description: Add codument/decisions storage conventions and archive-time promotion support for durable decisions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: codument/decisions can be created when durable decisions are promoted
Decision paths use YYYY-MM bucket and minute-level prefix
decision:// references are represented in promoted decision files

task.name: Add optional project memory registry
task.description: Add projectMemory-gated promotion of lessons, incidents, patterns, and summaries without central index files.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: projectMemory disabled means no memory directory is created
Enabled memory writes to lessons/incidents/patterns/summaries/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD-HHmm-slug/
No codument/memory/index.md is generated

phase.name: Knowledge sync and prompt workflow updates

task.name: Implement knowledge sync feature gating
task.description: Respect knowledgeSync.enabled and configured targets when generating plans and archive-time knowledge hints.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Disabled knowledgeSync creates no knowledge hints
Enabled knowledgeSync reads configured targets
Absolute target roots are allowed only when explicitly configured

task.name: Add docs knowledge attractor template
task.description: Create a neutral docs knowledge attractor template that explains canonical, derived, implementation, operational, and reference knowledge without hard-coding a project type.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Template is project-neutral
Template includes multiple project type examples
Template includes good/bad examples for same-name folder upgrades

task.name: Update codument-track prompt for large tracks
task.description: Teach codument-track to create proposal/ and design/ subdirectories for large tracks, with proposal.md and design.md as overview files.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Prompt identifies when a track is large enough to need proposal/ or design/
Prompt requires root files to reference subfiles
Prompt includes good/bad examples

task.name: Update archive and implement prompts
task.description: Update archive and implement prompts for VFS registry, decisions, memory, feature-gated knowledge sync, and minute-level archive paths.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Archive prompt describes new archive path and track updated time source
Archive prompt describes decision and memory promotion gates
Implement prompt adds docs sync tasks only when feature config enables knowledgeSync

task.name: Add unit and integration tests
task.description: Add focused tests for VFS parsing, feature config loading, XML spec parsing/patching, archive path generation, init, and upgrade-workspace compatibility.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: VFS parser tests pass
Feature config tests pass
Archive path tests pass
Init and upgrade-workspace tests pass
Upgrade tests cover legacy preservation for unsafe spec conversion

task.name: Update validate/list/show behavior
task.description: Ensure validate/list/show can handle XML specs, Markdown specs during compatibility, new archive layout, and optional registries.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: validate handles XML specs
list/show remain compatible with existing Markdown specs
archive listing handles old and new archive layouts

task.name: Run final verification
task.description: Run the project's test and typecheck commands and confirm generated prompts are internally consistent.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Automated tests pass
TypeScript typecheck passes if available
Generated Codument workflow skills include updated prompt behavior
